body.title: Results tables and their sentences
body.written_by_say: The tables, their footnotes and the sentences under them are built from the study's data by the program. No language model is involved.

text.heading: Body Weight
text.caption: Summary of Body Weights and Body Weight Gain of Female Rats Exposed to 1,2-DCB for Five Days
paragraphs: Body weight gain was significantly decreased in female rats at ≥500 ppm with a negative trend (Table 2). The BMD and BMDL were 273.4 and 215.4 ppm, respectively. Terminal body weight was significantly decreased in female rats at ≥500 ppm with a negative trend (Table 2). The BMD and BMDL were 298.1 and 133.7 ppm, respectively. Terminal body weight was significantly decreased in female rats at ≥500 ppm with a negative trend (Table 2). The BMD and BMDL were 227.1 and 116.4 ppm, respectively.

text.heading: Clinical Chemistry
text.caption: Summary of Select Clinical Chemistry Data for Female Rats Exposed to 1,2-DCB for Five Days
paragraphs: In female rats, Bile salts/acids was significantly increased at ≥250 ppm with a positive trend. The BMD and BMDL were 141.0 and 47.1 ppm, respectively. Cholesterol was significantly increased at ≥500 ppm with a positive trend. The BMD and BMDL were 238.4 and 147.3 ppm, respectively. Glucose was significantly decreased at ≥500 ppm with a negative trend. The BMD and BMDL were 360.3 and 184.0 ppm, respectively. A/G Ratio was significantly increased at ≥500 ppm with a positive trend. The BMD and BMDL were 182.3 and 99.4 ppm, respectively.

text.heading: Organ Weight
text.caption: Summary of Select Organ Weights of Female Rats Exposed to 1,2-DCB for Five Days
paragraphs: In female rats at study termination, a significant increase in Liver absolute and relative weight occurred in dose groups ≥100 ppm; these endpoints had positive trends (Table 3). The BMDs (BMDLs) were 113.9 (41.8) ppm (absolute weight) and 57.9 (29.9) ppm (relative weight), respectively. a significant increase in Kidney-Left relative weight occurred in dose groups ≥100 ppm; these endpoints had positive trends (Table 3). The BMD (BMDL) was 101.2 (40.9) ppm (relative weight). a significant increase in Kidney-Right relative weight occurred in dose groups ≥100 ppm; these endpoints had positive trends (Table 3). The BMD (BMDL) was 93.2 (43.2) ppm (relative weight).

text.heading: Tissue Concentration
text.caption: Summary of Blood, Lung, and Liver Concentration Data for Female Rats Exposed to 1,2-DCB for Five Days
paragraphs: Blood, lung, and liver concentrations of 1,2-DCB were measured on study days 4 and 5.
